WITH showcase_env AS (
    SELECT 
        s.caseID,
        COALESCE(AVG(erc."tempVar24"), 0) as avg_temp_var,
        COALESCE(AVG(erc."RHvar"), 0) as avg_rh_var,
        (s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state')->>'leak_rate_per_day'::float as leak_rate
    FROM "Showcases" s
    LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" erc ON s.caseID = erc.case_link
    GROUP BY s.caseID, (s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state')->>'leak_rate_per_day'
),
showcase_maintenance AS (
    SELECT 
        caseID,
        CASE WHEN (case_environment_profile->'maintenance')->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN (case_environment_profile->'maintenance')->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN (case_environment_profile->'maintenance')->>'silica_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        as critical_count
    FROM "Showcases"
),
showcase_sesr AS (
    SELECT 
        se.caseID,
        10 - ((COALESCE(se.avg_temp_var, 0) + (COALESCE(se.avg_rh_var, 0) / 5.0) + COALESCE(se.leak_rate, 0)) / 3.0) as sesr
    FROM showcase_env se
)
SELECT 
    sm.caseID,
    ROUND(CAST(ss.sesr AS numeric), 2) as sesr,
    sm.critical_count
FROM showcase_maintenance sm
JOIN showcase_sesr ss ON sm.caseID = ss.caseID
WHERE ss.sesr < 4 OR sm.critical_count >= 3
ORDER BY sm.caseID;
